subject: Draft: Azure private plan terms - Sentinel Health redlines
messages:
From: Alex Howard <alex.howard@sentinelhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sentinelhealth.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Draft - Azure Private Plan terms (Sentinel Health)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Attached are our internal redlines to the Azure Private Plan agreement and a short RFP that outlines our security and procurement requirements. High level asks from our side: 

- Stronger limits on telemetry/log retention and an explicit "no training"/data usage clause for customer content.
- Indemnity cap reduced or tied to committed spend rather than a flat unlimited exposure.
- Explicit audit/evidence path for SOC 2 & penetration test results during onboarding.
- Clarify marketplace listing entitlements and co-sell go-to-market commitments (we need an explicit Seller Authorization path).

Can you please route this to your legal and product teams and let me know a good time for a call tomorrow? We aim to finalize commercial terms by the end of the month to align with our procurement window.

Attachments: Sentinel_RFP_202606.pdf, Sentinel_Redlines.docx

Thanks,
Alex Howard
Head of Procurement | Sentinel Health
alex.howard@sentinelhealth.com
+1 415 555 0198

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Howard <alex.howard@sentinelhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft - Azure Private Plan terms (Sentinel Health)

Alex — thanks for sending these over and for the clear bullets. Looping in Marissa (legal) and Laura (finance/procurement playbook) to review. Quick notes from product/sales perspective before legal takes a pass: 

- Telemetry/logging: our runtime supports configurable telemetry and an opt-out for customer content logging at the tenant level; we can document controls and a default retention policy.
- Marketplace listing + Seller Authorization: we have a standard marketplace flow; we can commit to co-sell enablement but will need to confirm the exact marketplace entitlements you expect (metering, reseller split, etc.).

Marissa/Laura — can you review Sentinel's redlines and propose our counterpoints? Alex, I can do a 30-minute sync tomorrow 10:00-10:30 PT if that works, otherwise propose a slot.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Howard <alex.howard@sentinelhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft - Azure Private Plan terms (Sentinel Health)

Alex — appreciate the concise redlines. I reviewed the attached doc and here are our proposed positions (high level):

1) Data usage / training: we are willing to accept an explicit contractual commitment that Redwood will not use customer content to train models or for model improvements outside of aggregated non-identifiable telemetry. We will add a specific clause that customer content is processed only for inference and for necessary runtime operations.

2) Logging & retention: propose specific language that logging can be disabled for customer payloads and that any operational logs retained for debugging are retained for a maximum of 30 days unless otherwise agreed in writing. We will include an exception process for security incidents.

3) Indemnity cap: we cannot accept unlimited exposure. We propose a tiered cap tied to the greater of (a) annual committed spend under the contract or (b) $2M, with carve-outs for willful misconduct. If Sentinel can confirm an expected committed spend level, we can plug that into the cap calculation.

4) SOC 2 / audit evidence: we can provide our SOC 2 Type II report and recent penetration test summaries under an NDA; we will coordinate evidence upload to a secure share.

5) Marketplace Seller Authorization: we can commit to begin the Marketplace Seller Authorization workflow once the private plan commercial terms are agreed; however, co-sell commitments (joint marketing, lead sharing) will need an annex with measurable KPIs.

I attached a short redline with the proposed indemnity formula and data usage clause. Let me know if the indemnity cap approach is acceptable to Sentinel and confirm a time for a 30-minute call tomorrow (Karthik suggested 10:00 PT).

Attachments: Redwood_Terms_S1.pdf, redlines_sentinel.docx

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Alex Howard <alex.howard@sentinelhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, procurement@sentinelhealth.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft - Azure Private Plan terms (Sentinel Health)

Marissa/Karthik — thanks for the fast turnaround and the proposed language. Sentinel is comfortable with the indemnity approach tied to annual committed spend and the $2M floor. We also need the explicit logging opt-out and the promise not to use customer content for training placed verbatim in the DPA annex.

Next steps: 
- We will accept Marissa's redline in principle; I'll route this to our procurement/commercial team and get a PO number once we have the final DPA annex.
- Please upload SOC 2 Type II and pen-test summary to the secure share (or provide the link).
- I'll share a DocuSign envelope for the commercial schedule once internal approvals are complete.

Attachments: Procurement_SOW_v1.pdf

Can confirm the 10:00 PT call tomorrow — Alex will dial in.

Best,
Alex Howard
Head of Procurement | Sentinel Health
